title: Weather MCP Server by Meteosource
excerpt: Weather forecasts, alerts, air quality, 20 years of history and renewable production for AI agents over the Model Context Protocol. Hosted by Meteosource, nothing to install.
content_html:
Two values, and the agent is online

The server speaks the Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP. Every client needs the same two things: the address and your Meteosource API key in a header. The plan the key is on decides which tools the agent sees.

  1. Get a Meteosource API keySign up at meteosource.com; the free plan is enough to try the forecast tools.
  2. Add the server in your clientAddress https://mcp.meteosource.com/mcp, transport Streamable HTTP.
  3. Add the headerAuthorization: Bearer YOUR_METEOSOURCE_API_KEY. Clients with a plain API-key field can send X-API-Key instead.
  4. Ask about the weatherThe agent picks the right tools itself, from place lookup to forecast.

No OAuth, no sign-in.

The key travels in a request header, is used only to call Meteosource on your behalf and is never stored in full. Caches are kept per key.

Step-by-step setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and claude.ai, Codex, Antigravity and other clients, including team setups that keep the key out of version control, is in the Connect section of the README.

Seven tools, one weather API

The weather tools are for the Free, Startup and Standard plans; the production tools need the Renewables plan. See plans and pricing.
